Background.description: Other land-cover or scene regions that do not belong to the explicitly defined building, road, water, barren, forest, or agriculture categories in aerial imagery.

Building.description: Man-made buildings and constructed structures characterized by rooftops, regular geometric footprints, structural edges, and compact spatial shapes in aerial imagery.

Road.description: Transportation surfaces such as paved roads and streets, usually appearing as elongated, connected, and approximately linear structures in aerial imagery.

Water.description: Water-covered surfaces including rivers, lakes, ponds, canals, and other relatively homogeneous water regions visible from aerial imagery.

Barren.description: Bare or exposed land surfaces with little or no vegetation, including exposed soil, cleared ground, and non-vegetated open areas in aerial imagery.

Forest.description: Land dominated by dense trees and woody vegetation, typically characterized by irregular canopy structure, clustered crowns, and dense vegetation texture in aerial imagery.

Agriculture.description: Cultivated agricultural land including crop fields and farmland, often characterized by field parcels, repetitive planting patterns, regular boundaries, and agricultural vegetation textures in aerial imagery.
